notablePrerequisites:
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters.

description:
Give Walking Ballista deathtouch.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat steps 2-3.
